overrides.reason: gltfjsx-generated. The 'Auto-generated by / Command:' header at the top of each file is the source of truth; splitting them would be discarded by the next `pnpm dlx gltfjsx` run. See README > Regenerating the 3D models.

False positive. Every flagged input is wrapped in <Field label=... id=...> (Interface.jsx:336-357), which renders <label htmlFor={id}> at line 384. The rule does not look through the wrapper component.

VITE_WEB_ACCESS_TOKEN is a Web3Forms access key, which Web3Forms documents as public by design ('Do I need to hide access key? No... Access key is public.'). It aliases a destination inbox, it is not a credential. Real exposure is form spam, mitigated on Web3Forms' side.

Advisory only. Swapping to <dialog open>/showModal() would be needed to satisfy the rule and would rework the fade-out timing; tracked as a follow-up.
